part.text:
Implemented Handlebars-style templates, layouts, and partials.

- Added `templateDir` build option and CLI `--templates`.
- Supports `templates/*.hbs`, `templates/layouts/*.hbs`, and recursive `templates/partials/*.hbs`.
- Supports `{{value}}`, `{{{body}}}`, `{{{content}}}`, and `{{> partial}}`.
- Frontmatter supports `template` and `layout`; both default to `default`.
- Retains existing built-in HTML output when templates are absent.
- Added template/layout/partial tests.
